prerequisites.required: Bind the x86 PE/imports, TLS, SEH, C++/CRT initialization and delay/API-set loads to actual Win98 execution.

Validate existing synchronization and thread lifetime implementations against Chromium workloads.
Real Win98 process launch, handle/section passing, async IPC/completion and Mojo transport. No fake NT token/job/pipe success.
Actual Skia/Blink raster output to a Win98 window, shaping/font rasterization and DWrite/DirectComposition-free source paths; GPU switches alone are insufficient.
Real Winsock DNS/socket cancellation and current crypto/certificate validation for HTTPS/WebSocket. Reuse genuine ANSI CryptoAPI fixes where appropriate.
Actual x86 V8 execution, reservation/commit/protection, exception handling and mapped shared buffers within the guest address-space/RAM limits.

acceptance: Exact frozen x86 Chromium binary/source/DEPS/compiler inputs and unchanged Win98 IO.SYS evidence.
Fresh native OS/version/nonce log and complete required load-time/delay imports without success stubs.
Real browser window renders a local HTML/CSS/canvas/JavaScript fixture; typed input and DOM result read back from the owned guest.
Real navigation and separately authorized HTTPS/certificate/WebSocket fixtures; networkless bootstrap does not establish network acceptance.
Renderer process/IPC lifecycle, thread/TLS teardown, bounded resource accounting and external zero process exit.
